integrity: The proof derives a nested family of row fixed-point sets directly from P1-P5, conditional identity, and semicomplementation, then parametrizes each interior chain element by its first row of fixation. The recent primary paper and Holliday's preconditional paper were inspected at the exact algebraic axioms, derived monotonicity, T/F definitions, and Heyting characterization. Targeted indexed and literature searches did not locate a finite-chain classification or factorial count.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only preconditionals satisfying Chen's T-conditions, equivalently F-preconditionals on finite chains. Bare K-preconditionals and non-chain finite lattices are not classified. No free-algebra or general decision-complexity claim is made.
title: Factorial census of fundamental preconditionals on finite chains
